title: Tarui Application Manifest
description: Build-time manifest consumed by the Tarui CLI (tarui dev / tarui build). Runtime host configuration stays in appsettings.json; this file only drives frontend orchestration, output locations, bundle targets and product identity.

frontend.description: Frontend project root, relative to this manifest. Used as the working directory for beforeDevCommand / beforeBuildCommand. Defaults to the manifest directory.

beforeDevCommand.description: Command that starts the frontend dev server, e.g. 'pnpm dev'.

devUrl.description: HTTP(S) URL the dev server listens on. Injected into the host via TARUI_WEB_MODE=http and TARUI_WEB_URL.

beforeBuildCommand.description: Command that builds the frontend, e.g. 'pnpm build'.

frontendDist.description: Directory containing the built frontend (must contain index.html after beforeBuildCommand). Injected via TARUI_WEB_ROOT in scheme mode.

desktopProject.description: Desktop .csproj to run/publish. Optional: auto-detected when the app contains exactly one .csproj.
